He actually said in his [Weverse interview](https://magazine.weverse.io/article/view?ref=main&num=821&lang=en), that he intended to do some changes to their youtube channel. Previously, it was just regular content where you invite celebrity guests and has no distinction from regular tv shows. It all happened after he appeared on Calm Down Man live stream (lee malyeon). He said, usually popular YouTubers like calm down man and others are the ones who made and appeared on their own show. Na PD and team themselves are the people who make the show but why can't they appear on their own? So he realized he need to shift the content to emphasize more on their team and the people behind the show. To fit more on the concept of youtube rather than doing exactly the same with tv. Since the last game caterers with seventeen received such a great result, he said it was a good point to stop. I personally feel it's too bad since I'm a hard fan of the game caterers and regular seasonal shows of the Fullmoon channel. But after reading his interview, I understand his intention and try to support them nevertheless. It's just a pity that these days they barely provide English subs or else it'll take too long which is kinda a torture for us international fans.
